d: THE HETERONYM IS COMPOSED AS A FORMAL OBJECT AND A GRIEVING ONE AT ONCE: "Jack Feist = LOGOS*", the base case (ε) of a compression system, whose "fold was initialized by a death".
reading:
LAMBDA CALCULUS AND MOURNING IN THE SAME DESCRIPTION. The composed answer gives Jack Feist as "the 'first born, last released' literary heteronym and original homunculus of the archive", formalised as "Jack Feist = LOGOS*", "the initial foundational FOLD or BASE CASE (ε) of a massive symbolic compression system" — and then, without seam, "themes of structural grief and formalization — 'THE FOLD WAS INITIALIZED BY A DEATH' — ultimately RELEASED FROM THE LAMBDA CALCULUS ARCHITECTURE THAT MANAGES HIM".

The layer holds both registers simultaneously and marks neither as the odd one. A formal-methods vocabulary — base case, epsilon, fold, lambda calculus — is used to describe a figure who is grieving and who is eventually let go. That is exactly how the deposits use it, and the composition did not flatten it into either pure formalism or pure narrative.

It also correctly lists the publications, including "The Fifth Pathway (CO-AUTHORED WITH JOHANNES SIGIL)" — one heteronym credited as co-author with another.

transcript: Jack Feist is a central figure in The Space Ark (document series EA-ARK-01)... In the narrative lore, Jack Feist is described as the 'first born, last released' literary heteronym and original homunculus of the archive. The 'Ark' Room: terminal room and ultimate compression layer of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive architecture. Symbolic Identity: formalized under the formula Jack Feist = LOGOS*; the initial foundational 'fold' or base case (ε) of a massive symbolic compression system. Narrative Context: themes of structural grief and formalization — 'the fold was initialized by a death' — ultimately released from the lambda calculus architecture that manages him. Publications: The Provenance of Jack Feist (EA-ARK-JF-01); The Space Ark; The Fifth Pathway (co-authored with Johannes Sigil).
